authority: Human Authority owns Premium, WOW, Would Pay and UX Motion Quality. Leave results pending until explicit human input.
Technical FPS, CPU cost and callbacks cannot certify perceptual continuity.
Model-native capability, process compliance, artifact outcomes and ALFA contribution require separate evidence.

frame: Extract known facts with sources, constraints and unknowns. Never invent Project Truth.
If a missing fact blocks the brief, stop factual commitment; otherwise expose the uncertainty.
promise: Write what the visitor should feel, understand and be able to do. Ground the promise in supplied facts.
Treat premium as a contextual experience goal; do not choose a style from that word.
ambition: Explore before criticism. Retain model-native alternatives.
Propose structurally distinct directions by changing agency, mechanism, representation or temporal driver.
Protect useful amplitude. More effects does not mean better quality; quiet approaches remain eligible.
search: Record concept families and the structural difference between them. Palette swaps alone are insufficient.
Run generation and critique in separate passes. Reframe a shared premise before polishing several similar ideas.
signature: Choose a project-specific signature system connecting content, interaction, composition and rhythm.
Apply Logo Swap, Industry Swap, Effect Swap and Remove Asset tests; record reservations.
Require relevance, not a spectacular hero for every domain.
activation: Choose only knowledge that resolves current uncertainty. Record why each unit is needed.
Keep rejected/model-native alternatives observable. Treat implementation patterns as replaceable.
generation: Build only the minimum artifact capable of exposing the important perceptual claim.
Keep document controls native and responsive. Preserve readable meaning in reduced/static alternatives.
Use the selected procedural units. Record implementation decisions and their provenance.
critique: Inspect still endpoints, intermediate states and worst frames using actual rendering.
Test slow, normal, fast wheel, aggressive scrollbar drag, reverse, pause/resume, direction changes and resize where relevant.
Distinguish technical evidence from perceptual observations and Human Verdict.
repair: Capture preserve invariants before editing. Diagnose a concrete reproduced failure.
Verify both DEFECT REDUCED and VALUE PRESERVED. Restore meaningful agency and signature amplitude if smoothing weakens them.
Record before/after decision, evidence and unresolved risks; do not repeat low-information polish.
human-review: Freeze the artifact and pre-review prediction before receiving human feedback.
Present the experience before rationale, model name or framework claims. Record evaluator, device, input, order and prior knowledge.
Keep each evaluator's actual verdict and disagreement; do not average into a fake premium score.
evidence: Record claim, evidence type, authority, source, scope and limitations.
Record unchanged decisions and negative contribution as well as successes.
Stop when the next decision needs Human Authority or a new matched experiment. No automatic learning or Core promotion.
